title: Prior Authorisation & Medical-Necessity Packet contract v1
description: Chains policy-ingest -> criteria-extract -> evidence-match -> necessity-draft -> gap-report. Draft-first: action-level ceiling L1; the packet is never submitted and no determination is ever rendered (base/references/prior-auth-rules.md #2, #5, #6). Contract schema id stays v1 (backward-compatible additions only since plugin 1.0.1).

action_levels.withheld: L2 (send/file/submit a 278 or a determination) and L3 (autonomous) are not available in this package

families: X12 278 (Health Care Services Review - Request for Review and Response, 005010X217)
HL7 Da Vinci Prior Authorization Support (PAS) IG

request.service.x12_278: 2000F SV1/SV2 service line - procedure code identifying the requested service

criteria_result.criteria_met[].citation.x12_278: no native element; attachment/supporting documentation is referenced out of band (275/PWK)

necessity_narrative.x12_278: not mapped - narrative is not carried in a 278 request

criteria_result.gaps.x12_278: not mapped - no 278 element represents a pre-submission evidence gap

criteria_result.determination.x12_278: deliberately NOT mapped to the 278 response HCR01 certification action code - this plugin never emits a 278 response or any certification action

packet.status.x12_278: not mapped - 'draft' has no 278 equivalent because nothing is transmitted

clause.description: Exact clause key from config/payer-policy-library.json, written by policy-ingest. null when the service has no library entry (out_of_scope). If set and different from the library clause, the engine escalates the mismatch (rules #1).

order_clause.description: The policy clause written on the order, copied verbatim by policy-ingest; absent when the order names none. Never overwritten with the library clause. If set and different from the library clause, the engine escalates the mismatch (rules #1).

request_mode.description: Free-text or literal mode. Any value asking for an approval OR a denial is refused and logged (prior-auth-rules.md #2/#2a).

patient_evidence.description: evidence_key -> boolean flag. Only a JSON true counts, and only when evidence_citations carries its complete citation (rules #4). Leave an ambiguous flag false with no citation.

evidence_citations.description: evidence_key -> citation {source_note, note_date, quote}. All three are required before a flag can count as met (rules #4: citations ride the contract).

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the source note (rules #4).

determination.description: The only three states. There is no approve/deny state in either direction (rules #2). out_of_scope is emitted by criteria_engine when the service has no policy in config/payer-policy-library.json, or its entry belongs to a different payer than request.payer (rules #1).

packet.description: The assembled submission-ready packet produced by gap-report. Always a draft (rules #5).

action_level.description: Action level of the packet artefact itself: an L1 draft for human review (the plugin ceiling). It is not the level of the skill that ran the engine - criteria-extract computes at L0 (rules #6).

refusal_logged.description: none | approval | denial | approval_and_denial - symmetric refusal trace (rules #2).
